investigation_notes.Description: 315 SharePoint file downloads were observed from Marcus Webb in Tallinn, Estonia, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 50. The activity targeted the Legal_M_A site on SharePoint Online and included confidential documents such as Confidential_Board_Minutes_Jan2026.pdf, indicating access to sensitive data. Access used a standard browser through Office 365 SharePoint Online during local working hours; due to the volume and data sensitivity, this activity is high-priority pending verification of legitimate business justification.
